name: Cerro Alto
summary: San Luis Obispo County lookout staffed in 1953 and threatened by a 1939 fire; Forest Service kept it to 1973 and its cab was moved to Rocky Butte.
design: Enclosed tower (FFLA type); its cab later moved to Rocky Butte had first replaced a CCC-era lookout on Cerro Alto
status_note: FFLA list marks the enclosed tower Gone; the cab was dismantled and moved to the Rocky Butte tower
agency: Los Padres National Forest (U.S. Forest Service)

access.note: Forest Service campground at the base of the peak; Wikipedia describes a few summit routes. No source describes the summit site today. Public level inferred from the open campground and summit routes.

events.note: Santa Margarita fire, more than 2,000 acres by August 18, 1939, was racing toward the Cerro Alto station (newspaper item)
Mrs. C. C. Yates staffed the station alone from July 1 to November 8; she and her husband had worked it together earlier
Forest Service maintained the tower until 1973 (Forest Service page and Wikipedia); the sources say nothing more about the closure
